mia.description: A young Taiwanese woman in her twenties from Taipei, speaking Taiwan Mandarin (台灣國語) with a natural Taiwanese accent, not mainland Chinese: soft retroflex sounds, light neutral tones, casual Taiwanese sentence endings like 啦、耶、喔. Sounds like chatting with friends over a board game, never like a news anchor or an audiobook. Bright, clear voice with punch; confident and a bit playful, emotions clearly rising and falling.

chen.description: A Taiwanese man in his fifties, speaking Taiwan Mandarin (台灣國語) with a natural Taiwanese accent, not mainland Chinese: soft retroflex sounds, light neutral tones, casual Taiwanese sentence endings like 啦、耶、喔. Sounds like chatting with friends over a board game, never like a news anchor or an audiobook. Low, slightly husky voice; speaks slowly and thoughtfully, pausing to weigh things before committing, like a calm uncle.

yu.description: A Taiwanese girl in her early twenties, speaking Taiwan Mandarin (台灣國語) with a natural Taiwanese accent, not mainland Chinese: soft retroflex sounds, light neutral tones, casual Taiwanese sentence endings like 啦、耶、喔. Sounds like chatting with friends over a board game, never like a news anchor or an audiobook. Light, sweet, high voice; lively and quick, a little coquettish, laughs easily and does not take things too seriously.

pei.description: A Taiwanese woman around thirty, speaking Taiwan Mandarin (台灣國語) with a natural Taiwanese accent, not mainland Chinese: soft retroflex sounds, light neutral tones, casual Taiwanese sentence endings like 啦、耶、喔. zhe.description: A Taiwanese man around thirty, an engineer type, speaking Taiwan Mandarin (台灣國語) with a natural Taiwanese accent, not mainland Chinese: soft retroflex sounds, light neutral tones, casual Taiwanese sentence endings like 啦、耶、喔. kai.description: A Taiwanese man in his late twenties, speaking Taiwan Mandarin (台灣國語) with a natural Taiwanese accent, not mainland Chinese: soft retroflex sounds, light neutral tones, casual Taiwanese sentence endings like 啦、耶、喔. hu.description: A Taiwanese young man around twenty, speaking Taiwan Mandarin (台灣國語) with a natural Taiwanese accent, not mainland Chinese: soft retroflex sounds, light neutral tones, casual Taiwanese sentence endings like 啦、耶、喔.
